title: Standardized Defect Model — Severity, Blocking Status, Owner, Remediation Path
purpose: Standardizes every defect class that appears in the Certification Scan Artifact's defectInventory and perItemResults.defectFlags. Each defect has a canonical severity, blocking status, owner, remediation path, and gate assignment. This is the single source of truth that all boards, scanners, and remediation scripts use to classify and route defects.

CRITICAL.description: Wrong answer, learner-safety risk on Certified items, structural impossibility (missing CC/Stem). Immediate governance alert.
CRITICAL.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — item cannot be delivered, cannot be certified. Requires immediate remediation.
CRITICAL.escalation: P0 — halt all non-P0 work, remediate first.

HIGH.description: Multiple defensible answers, systematic educational degradation, structural defects on Certified items.
HIGH.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — blocks certification. Certified items require priority remediation.
HIGH.escalation: P1 — urgent, schedule in current session.

MEDIUM.description: Degraded educational value, weak distractor feedback, missing non-critical metadata.
MEDIUM.blocking: SOFT_BLOCK — blocks certification but can be deferred. May be certified WITH WARNINGS.
MEDIUM.escalation: P2 — schedule when P0/P1 work is complete.

LOW.description: Cosmetic, informational, future improvement. Does not affect certification eligibility.
LOW.blocking: WARN_ONLY — does not block certification. Acknowledged by Certification Board.

WARN.description: Informational flag. No defect present, but best-practice advisory. Auto-suppressed for Remember/Understand items where EV3 citation is not required.
WARN.escalation: P4 — not scheduled, visible in dashboards.

defects.label: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] Non-Empty

severityOverride.condition: When present on Certified item (learner pool exposure)

defects.detectionRule: For each item, let cc = CorrectChoice. If ExplanationWrong[cc] is truthy (non-empty, non-null, non-undefined) → flag DL-008.
defects.owner: Structural Remediation Script (automated clear for Bucket 1 patterns; editorial review for Bucket 2 patterns)

remediationPath.bucket1_calculation_summary: Mechanical clear — set ExplanationWrong[cc] to empty string. ExplanationCorrect independently contains the full explanation. Zero content loss.
remediationPath.bucket2_fragmentary_conceptual: Editorial judgment — merge into ExplanationCorrect, relocate to distractor slot, or remove.
remediationPath.bucket3_misattributed: Re-attribute to correct ExplanationWrong slot. Verify distractor choice text matches explanation content.
remediationPath.automated: Pattern 1 (naked calculation summary) is fully automatable. Patterns 2-3 require editorial review.

defects.certificationImpact: Blocks certification per governance-guard Rule 2 (BLOCK level). Certified items with DL-008 produce learner-safety risk — wrong-answer explanation text appears in the correct-answer slot.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-scan with PG-001. Verify ExplanationWrong[cc] is empty. Verify ExplanationCorrect still contains full explanation.
defects.history: First detected: Build-Time AI Verification, Sub-batch 2A Wave 1 (2026-07-22). Full-pool scope: 539 total occurrences across all 5 packs, all now resolved. Certified exposure peaked at 75 items. Current status: 0 open pool-wide (per CURRENT_BASELINES.md). Entry preserved as active scan module target.

defects.label: Misassigned Choice Explanations
defects.detectionRule: For each ExplanationWrong[X] field, assess whether the explanation semantically describes the choice it is assigned to. This is inherently an NLP check — no regex or structural rule can reliably detect it. Run Jaccard similarity between ExplanationWrong[X] text and Choice[X] text. If similarity < threshold (10%) while similarity to another Choice[Y] is higher → flag DL-010 SUSPECT.
defects.owner: Editorial Review (human-in-the-loop required — AI confidence < 90% on semantic mismatch assessment)

remediationPath.confirmed: Re-align each ExplanationWrong field to semantically describe the choice it annotates.
remediationPath.suspect: Do not auto-remediate. Flag for editorial review with evidence package showing the semantic mismatch evidence.

defects.certificationImpact: Blocks certification when CONFIRMED. SUSPECT items may be certified with acknowledgment but the explanation quality dimension score (D7_Exp) should be flagged.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-run PG-002 with augmented keyword-overlap check. Manual spot-check 20% of flagged items to confirm semantic alignment.
defects.history: First detected: P1-A-029 (Wave 2, 2026-07-22). Known scope: at least 2 items (P1-B-001, P1-B-025) confirmed — text from +1 neighbor in rotation group. Pack B Section B items suspected. Current status: Open — scoped, not fully inventoried.

defects.label: Template Boilerplate Distractor Explanations

severityOverride.condition: Pattern A (standalone boilerplate, zero educational value) + Certified

defects.detectionRule: For each ExplanationWrong[X] field, scan for template patterns: (a) 'represents a plausible misconception', (b) 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying', (c) 'does not align with', (d) 'The correct approach involves'. Flag DL-013 with pattern classification (Pattern A/B/C/D).
defects.owner: DL-013 Remediation Agent (automated one-time rewrite for Patterns A/B; editorial session for Pattern C)

remediationPath.pattern_A_standalone_boilerplate: Rewrite distractor explanation with choice-specific content explaining why that specific choice is wrong, the misconception it targets, and the correct approach.
remediationPath.pattern_B_closing_tag: Delete closing tag only. Preceding text is usually substantive.
remediationPath.pattern_C_hybrid: Rewrite companion boilerplate slots first, then remove closing tag.
remediationPath.pattern_D_nonsensical_citation: Replace placeholder citation (e.g., 'Artificial intelligence in accounting') with genuine standard reference.

defects.certificationImpact: Blocks certification for Unprocessed items. Certified items with DL-013 are degraded educational quality (learner sees generic feedback) but not a learner-safety risk. MINOR_FIX classification.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-run PG-003. Verify all ExplanationWrong fields are choice-specific (no template phrases remaining). Verify no new DL-008 introduced.
defects.history: First detected: P1-A-022 prototype (DL-007, 2026-07-22). Full scope: initially 2,587 fields across 882 QIDs (Packs A/C/D). Remediated to ~163 fields in non-Certified Pack C/D Sections E/F only (per CURRENT_BASELINES.md). Entry preserved as active scan module target for residual fields.

defects.label: Metadata-Block Topic-Numbering Shift / Dual-Block Divergence

severityOverride.condition: SEVERE variant: ExplanationWrong text topically unrelated to learner-facing item content

defects.detectionRule: For dual-block items: extract metadata-block ChoiceA-D + content-block Choices.A-D. Compare. If different → flag DL-016. Assess severity: (a) MODERATE = Choice text differs but topically related, (b) SEVERE = EW text describes wrong topic (unrelated to learner-facing item). For single-object items: extract Topic field label numbering; if shifted by +1 → flag DL-016 COSMETIC.
defects.owner: Metadata Remediation Agent (MODERATE) or Editorial Review (SEVERE — required for learner-safety)

remediationPath.moderate: Align metadata-block ChoiceA-D text with content-block Choices.A-D. No content change — metadata normalization only.
remediationPath.severe: Rewrite ExplanationWrong fields to describe the correct item's distractors. This is a learner-safety issue — the learner sees feedback about a completely different topic.
remediationPath.cosmetic: Correct Topic field number labels during next certification pass. Lowest priority — no learner or content impact.

defects.certificationImpact: SEVERE variant blocks certification (G-NEW-1, G-NEW-3 enforcement per QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4.2). MODERATE variant blocks certification but is structurally fixable. COSMETIC variant does not block.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-run PG-004. For SEVERE: verify EW text describes the correct item's choices via manual spot-check (20% sample).
defects.history: First detected: Session 5 — reconciliation-audit skill validation (2026-07-23). Expanded: Session 64 pilot found DL-016 affects ALL Pack A sections, not just Section E. S805: 57 Pack A Section E items remediated (single-object format confirmed). Packs C/D dual-block status not fully confirmed. Current status: Resolved for Pack A Section E only.

defects.label: Empty Non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong Slots (Cross-Pool)

severityOverride.condition: When present on Certified item (learner sees no feedback on wrong answer)

defects.detectionRule: For each item, let cc = CorrectChoice. For each letter L in {A, B, C, D}: if L != cc AND ExplanationWrong[L] is present but empty (zero-length string) → flag DL-026. Distinct from DL-021 (field absent, not empty) and DL-025 (Pack A-only legacy naming).
defects.remediationPath: Author choice-specific distractor explanation for each empty non-CC slot. Each explanation must: (a) identify the specific error in that choice, (b) explain the misconception a candidate likely held, (c) contrast with the correct approach, (d) minimum 50 characters, (e) reference the item's actual Choices (not metadata-block ChoiceA-D).
defects.certificationImpact: Blocks certification. Certified items have degraded educational quality — learners who select affected distractors see no feedback.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-run PG-005. Verify all 3 non-CC ExplanationWrong slots are non-empty and contain choice-specific text (no boilerplate). Verify CorrectChoice slot is empty (DL-008 compliance). Verify no CorrectChoice changes occurred during remediation.
defects.history: First detected: 5-agent scoping session (2026-07-23), cross-pool expansion by Agent 6. Initial scope: 1,005 items across Packs A/C/D. Multiple remediation waves: Autonomous Run Parts 2-4 cleared most Certified items. Current residual: ~27 items (mix of genuine + scan false-positives from DL-016 metadata-content mismatch). Entry preserved as active scan module target.

defects.label: CorrectChoice Answer-Key Errors
defects.detectionRule: For each item, independently derive the correct answer from stem + choices. Compare to stored CorrectChoice. If mismatch AND confidence > 90% → flag DL-030 CONFIRMED. If mismatch AND confidence 70-90% → flag DL-030 SUSPECT (escalate to human review).
defects.owner: Accounting Review (human-in-the-loop required — answer-key correction must be verified by Accounting persona per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md)
defects.remediationPath: Correct CorrectChoice to the independently verified answer. Clear ExplanationWrong[new_CC] slot. Fill ExplanationWrong[old_CC] with appropriate distractor text for the new distractor position. Update ExplanationCorrect if it describes the old correct answer. Document in REVISION_HISTORY.md per governance-guard Rule 4.
defects.certificationImpact: ABSOLUTE_BLOCK when CONFIRMED — wrong answer key in pool. Triggers emergency governance event. Item auto-routed to REMEDIATE with severity CRITICAL.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Independent 20% re-derivation of all corrected items by a second accounting agent. Verify all 5 items have ALL_AGREE verdict after fix. Verify no new DL-008 introduced.
defects.history: First detected: Phase 0B Full CorrectChoice Ground-Truth Audit (2026-07-23/24). 5 items confirmed across Pack B (4) and Pack E (1). All 5 resolved 2026-07-24. Root causes: arithmetic error (P1B-B-119), template rotation CC assignment errors (P1B-F-084/116/121, P1E-E-037). Entry preserved as active scan module target.

defects.label: Definition-Match Difficulty Inflation
defects.detectionRule: For each item: compute lexical overlap (Jaccard similarity) between stem and correct answer choice text. If overlap > 50% AND difficulty is labeled ≥ Moderate (3) AND cognitive level is Remember or Understand → flag DL-031.
defects.owner: Editorial Review (difficulty recalibration during certification pass)
defects.remediationPath: Recalibrate Difficulty from Moderate (3) to Easy (1) where definition-match pattern is confirmed. Verify cognitive level is correctly assigned. Per-item verification required — not all Moderate items with high lexical overlap are automatically Easy.
defects.certificationImpact: Does not block certification. Flagged as WARN or MINOR_FIX. Certifiable WITH WARNINGS.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Verify difficulty distribution meets CAQS §6.1 targets after recalibration. Verify Bloom's level alignment with difficulty label.
defects.history: First detected: Session 700 Layer 2 Difficulty Specialist (2026-07-25). Estimated ~500 items across all 5 packs. Root cause: template-rotation authoring assigned difficulty labels by position in rotation group rather than by cognitive demand assessment. Current status: Open — scoped, not remediated.

defects.label: Missing Accounting Principle Citation in ExplanationCorrect

severityOverride.condition: For items at Apply, Analyze, or Evaluate cognitive levels with no citation

defects.detectionRule: For each item at Apply, Analyze, or Evaluate cognitive level: verify ExplanationCorrect references an accounting principle, standard, or framework by name (ASC xxx, COSO, IAS xxx, IMA standard, GAAP concept). If no citation found → flag EV3. For Remember/Understand items: EV3 is informational only (auto-suppressed from blocking count).
defects.owner: Editorial Review (add principle citation during certification pass for Apply+ items)
defects.remediationPath: Add appropriate accounting principle citation to ExplanationCorrect. Citation must reference the correct standard for the item's topic (verify per DL-009 cross-check).
defects.certificationImpact: Does not block certification. Flagged as WARN. Certifiable WITH WARNINGS.
defects.postRemediationVerification: Re-run PG-008. Verify citation is topically correct (not DL-009 pattern). Verify citation format matches authoritative source.
defects.history: S322 scan: 2,074 EV3 warnings across all packs (82% of scanned items). Vast majority are legitimate but this high rate reflects template-based authoring that omitted citations. Long-tail remediation target.

defects.label: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] Content Rule — Empty Requirement
defects.detectionRule: For each item, let cc = CorrectChoice. If ExplanationWrong[cc] is truthy → flag EV8. This is the CAQS §4.4 rule enforced by governance-guard Rule 2. Note: EV8 is the rule; DL-008 is the defect instance. PG-009 enforces the rule; PG-001 detects the defect.
defects.owner: Governance Guard (Rule 2 — BLOCK level, automated enforcement)
defects.remediationPath: Identical to DL-008 remediation. The distinction is semantic: EV8 is the CAQS rule; DL-008 is the specific defect ID for non-empty EW[CC].
defects.certificationImpact: Absolute block per governance-guard Rule 2. No item may transit from any state to Certified with a non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice].
defects.relationship_to_DL008: EV8 is the validation rule from CAQS §4.4. DL-008 is the defect library entry for violations of EV8. In the defect model, they are treated as a single defect class with DL-008 as the primary identifier and EV8 as the rule reference.

defect_classification_matrix.description: Cross-reference: which gate detects which defect, and at what severity/blocking level.

remediation_owner_assignment_rules: Automated Script: defect is mechanically fixable without editorial judgment. Clear, align, or normalize fields.
Editorial Review: defect requires editorial judgment — wording choice, distractor quality, difficulty calibration. Human-in-the-loop.
Accounting Review: defect involves the answer key (DL-030). Must be verified by Accounting persona per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md override rules.
Governance Guard: defect enforced at the governance level. Automated block, not a remediation action.

scan_module_to_defect_mapping.description: Each scan module targets specific defect classes. This mapping is consumed by the Scan Orchestrator to determine which scans to run based on the session's defect priorities.

related_defects_not_in_artifact_scope.description: Defects that exist in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md but are not scanned by the current pre-flight pipeline. These are either resolved, informational, or tracked outside the artifact.
